sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
2.5.3

  • Leads CRM Visual Overhaul: Replaced icon buttons and complex layouts with flat, clean, Notion-inspired rows, thin SVGs, and consistent monochromatic borders.
  • Team Member Assignment: Added a team member filter selector in the Leads CRM toolbar, Kanban cards, directory list, and drawers.
  • One-Tap Lead Status Transition: Enabled quick status updates directly from the Kanban list and the main drawer interface.
  • SLA & Priority Awareness: Integrated a prominent SLA status header card, dynamic activity logs, and real-time validation checks.
